name: Storm Coast

sim.terrain: rocky shore, tide pools, sea stacks

advantages_hint: electric and aquatic creatures thrive; amphibious fighters can use both zones; fire powers are damped by rain and spray; fliers are battered by gusts and risk lightning; heavy land bruisers slip on wet rock
visual_hint: night storm over black rocks, forked lightning, huge waves exploding on sea stacks, driving rain, cold blue-white light

name: Deep Ocean

sim.terrain: open water column above an abyssal plain

advantages_hint: deep-sea swimmers, sonar users and glowing lures dominate; anything that needs air or sunlight tires fast; fire is useless; fliers and land creatures are almost helpless; armor helps against pressure but weight drags
visual_hint: near-black blue water, faint bioluminescent motes drifting, one shaft of dim light from far above, vast empty depth

name: Volcanic Shore

sim.terrain: cracked basalt, lava flows, steaming black-sand beach
sim.airspace: open but full of hot updrafts and ash

advantages_hint: fire and heat-proof creatures thrive and can even be strengthened; cold-adapted and thick-furred creatures overheat quickly; fliers get free lift from thermals but ash clogs breathing; water creatures are stranded in scalding shallows
visual_hint: orange lava veins across black rock, glowing sea steam where lava meets water, ash haze, ember sparks rising, red-lit sky

name: Jungle Canyon

sim.terrain: narrow gorge, vine-covered walls, river running through the floor
sim.airspace: tight and enclosed above the canopy gap
sim.cover: dense — vines, ferns, huge tree trunks

advantages_hint: climbers, ambushers and camouflaged stalkers thrive; venom and stealth pay off in close quarters; giant creatures can barely turn between the walls; big fliers have no room for wings, though gliders can drop from the rim
visual_hint: deep green gorge with sunbeams cutting through mist, hanging vines, waterfall down a mossy cliff, river below

name: Frozen Ridge

sim.terrain: wind-scoured ice ridge, crevasses, deep snow drifts

advantages_hint: furred and blubbered cold specialists thrive; white creatures vanish in the snow; fire creatures burn energy fast just staying warm; heavy creatures crack thin ice; fliers get thrown around by crosswinds; cold-blooded reptiles slow right down
visual_hint: blue-white glacial ridge under a pale sky, spindrift blowing off the crest, deep shadowed crevasses, low arctic sun

name: Open Sky

sim.terrain: no ground at all — cloud towers and open air

advantages_hint: true fliers own this arena and can dictate every exchange; gliders survive by trading height for speed; anything that cannot fly must cling, grapple or fall; thin air punishes heavy bodies and big lungs
visual_hint: towering sunlit cloud canyons, deep blue above, distant land far below, streaming vapour trails, brilliant high-altitude light

name: Desert Ruins

sim.terrain: sun-baked sand, toppled columns, half-buried stone corridors
sim.airspace: open, with dust devils and thermals

advantages_hint: burrowers, heat-tolerant reptiles and desert runners thrive; sand-coloured creatures ambush from cover; water-dependent and thick-furred creatures dry out fast; giant creatures cannot fit through the ruined corridors; fliers see everything but find little shade
visual_hint: gold sandstone ruins half-swallowed by dunes, hard blue shadows, blowing sand veil, heat shimmer, long low sun

name: Swamp

sim.terrain: black water, sucking mud, cypress roots and floating mats
sim.airspace: cluttered with low branches and hanging moss

advantages_hint: amphibious ambushers, venom users and mud-camouflaged lurkers thrive; regeneration shines in a long grinding fight; heavy armored creatures sink and bog down; fire sputters in the wet; fast runners lose all their speed; fliers snag on low branches
visual_hint: green-black still water, cypress knees, hanging moss, low mist glowing in shafts of dim light, ripples spreading

name: City Harbor

sim.terrain: concrete piers, shipping containers, gantry cranes, moored hulls
sim.airspace: open above the water but crowded with cranes and cables

advantages_hint: climbers, clever problem-solvers and creatures comfortable in both water and on land thrive; big swimmers can strike at the piers; containers give great cover to ambushers; colossal creatures smash their own footing away; fliers must dodge cranes and cables
visual_hint: night harbor with sodium-orange dock lights, stacked containers, crane silhouettes, dark reflective water, drifting fog
